blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Merely hours after it lifted its power supply warning, the National Grid Corp. of the Philippines (NGCP) on Saturday raised again the yellow alert over the Visayas power grid from 5 p.m. to 8 p.m. The warning comes as the power plants remained unavailable and maintenance work affected electricity supply. A yellow alert indicates that the power supply can still meet demand, but there is a warning that a plant breakdown could lead to power outages. In an advisory, the NGCP said the Visayas grid had an available capacity of 2,511 megawatts (MW) against a projected peak demand […]...
